$comment: Hebbian-threshold sensitivity sweep on the same grid + seed as hebbian_eval.json.
Three cells at the same seed so the difference comes from the threshold alone:
threshold=0.05 (loose)            : aggressive drift, every weakly-correlated peer admitted
Comparing recluster event counts and downstream PWSF tells us the dose-response curve
of dynamic-emergent membership refinement under Aoki/Aoyagi (2009).
